# B"H
<!-- Boruch Hashem -->
<!-- Blessed is He -->

# Final Execution Plan

> The Awtsmoos renews each promise until timing and truth agree;
> Awtsmoos.com gives every compact chamber its original directory.

## Proven Defects

1. `MinimalSharedMeadowReadinessFlow.js` inspects six bootstrap systems before `diagnostics.featuresPromise` installs them.
2. `RemoteModelCatalog.js` uses the repository prefix `/geelooy/games/...` as a browser URL instead of `/games/...`.
3. Runtime importer callbacks receive relative strings that become relative to `mitzvah-world.compact.js` after folding.
4. The same hidden-import pattern exists in chat and optional launcher entries.

## Authorized Full-File Writes

### Runtime Source

1. `src/launcher/MinimalSharedMeadowReadinessFlow.js`
   - Await the bounded bootstrap settlement before essential readiness inspection.
   - Preserve optional rich hydration after playable publication.
   - Propagate bootstrap failure honestly.

2. `src/assets/RemoteModelCatalog.js`
   - Separate public URL root from repository filesystem root.
   - Preserve content-addressed identity, trust validation, and evidence APIs.

3. `src/network/MultiplayerOptionalUi.js`
   - Convert chat factory and panel dependencies to source-aware absolute URLs built from `import.meta.url`.
   - Preserve injected importer behavior and cancellation semantics.

4. `src/launcher/MinimalMeadowOptionalEntries.js`
   - Convert API explorer and mobile dependency requests to source-aware absolute URLs.
   - Preserve lazy loading and query-driven behavior.

### New Focused Tests

5. `src/test/launcher/minimalSharedMeadowReadinessFlow.test.mjs`
   - Prove bootstrap settlement precedes readiness inspection.
   - Prove rich optional hydration remains non-blocking.

6. `src/test/assets/remoteModelCatalog.test.mjs`
   - Prove public URL begins `/games/` while repository path begins `geelooy/games/`.
   - Prove trusted identity and SHA directory remain intact.

7. `src/test/network/compactOptionalImportUrls.test.mjs`
   - Prove injected importers receive absolute source-aware network and app URLs.
   - Prove no raw relative runtime specifier remains.

8. `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/tests/compactJs.mitzvahWorldRuntime.test.js`
   - Compile the real minimal meadow page entry.
   - Syntax-check output.
   - Assert corrected readiness, public model path, and compact-safe importer contracts.

### Generated and Durable Artifacts

9. `src/mitzvah-world.compact.js`
   - Regenerate in full with `compileCompactModule` from the verified real page entry.

10. `NEXT_AI_README.md` and `REMAINING_WORK.md`
   - Rewrite only after browser verification so handoff reflects evidence rather than intention.

## Explicit Non-Targets

- Do not modify `MinimalMeadowLootDropState.js` or its tests; they contain unrelated user work.
- Do not edit the 697-line CompactJS compiler unless a focused compiler test proves its documented literal-import contract fails.
- Do not hand-patch generated bundle text.
- Do not suppress readiness errors or model fallbacks.

## Execution Order

1. Re-read and hash all four source targets.
2. Search for every matching injected relative-import pattern.
3. Rewrite source targets in full.
4. Write focused tests in full.
5. Read back all new source and tests.
6. Run syntax and focused tests.
7. Compile the actual page entry and regenerate the compact bundle.
8. Run CompactJS suites and generated-bundle assertions.
9. Reload the public page with cache busting.
10. Verify DOM readiness, runtime systems, asset responses, console, and network.
11. Resolve any newly revealed failures.
12. Re-read all touched files and write planned-versus-actual evidence.
13. Rewrite handoff and remaining-work documents only when the completion gate is satisfied.
